integrity: The iteration matrix, discriminant, monotonicity on both spectral regimes, and ratio conversion are derived explicitly.

The Malitsky--Pock algorithm and fixed-step linesearch condition were inspected in the full source text; Fercoq's later quadratic spectral-radius framework was inspected in full text at the relevant matrix and rate passages.

limitations: Exact scalar least-squares result for the fixed-step \(\theta=1\) specialization only.
Optimizes asymptotic spectral radius at fixed product; it does not solve the multi-singular-value minimax ratio problem or finite-horizon transient optimization.
An unindexed or differently phrased scalar PDHG tuning analysis may contain an equivalent closed form.
title: Critical-damping ratio for scalar least-squares primal-dual linesearch
